findings.description: After a fault-free start-up with no window-watchdog refresh, the requirement bounds the first refresh under SWR-WDG-004 even if a fault is detected before that refresh. SWR-WDG-001 prohibits servicing from fault detection until reset.
findings.requested_change: Condition the first-refresh obligation on no fault being detected before that refresh, consistently with SWR-WDG-001.

findings.description: The requirement combines independently verifiable bounds for consecutive refreshes, the first refresh after enabling, the end of start-up, and the transition when no refresh occurs during start-up.
findings.requested_change: Separate the independently judgeable obligations while preserving their conditions and timing bounds.

findings.description: SYS-SUP-054 requires the test or demonstration verification of every system requirement on the simulator or host tests. SWR-TST-002 limits this provision to software requirements, leaving the system-level verification scope unaddressed.
findings.requested_change: Address the allocated support for verification of all applicable system requirements, or document and trace the allocation that provides it.
